Unique equal-law pair at fourteen tips and absence for smaller sizes proven in bounded class; each full law counted over all 2^14 subsets. No infinite-size claim.

Joint reconstruction does not imply marginal reconstruction; the fourteen-tip witness expressly separates them. Moment forward formulas do not imply injectivity.

originality.rationale: Unlike Nipperess--Matsen forward mean/variance, Fischer--Liebscher weaker split sequences, and Evans--Lanoue joint nested-subtree-length sampling, this gives the sharp first collision of all separate marginal diversity laws. Equivalent theory could exist under another polynomial invariant, so independent novelty verification is not certified.
residual_risks: Novelty searches cannot rule out an equivalent leaf-subset-distance polynomial under another name or an unindexed theorem.

value.rationale: Ecological rarefaction is a standard biodiversity observable. The sharp fourteen-taxon obstruction proves that even *all* marginal distribution curves are not globally sufficient to infer shape, while weaker statistics already suffice through thirteen; contrasts critically with joint nested-sampling identifiability and provides an exact information-loss boundary relevant to sampling design.
